title: Biggest Bundesliga grounds
brief: Name the ten 2025/26 Bundesliga clubs with the biggest home grounds by capacity.
period: The 18 clubs of the 2025/26 Bundesliga, league capacity
checks: Capacities from Wikipedia's 2025/26 stadiums table (which cites each club's own site), fussballdaten.de's 2025/26 stadium table and each club's Transfermarkt stadium page. The figure shown is one at least two of them agree on. All three agree on the top ten clubs and on Mainz 11th. Stuttgart and Frankfurt are both about 60,000 and the sources disagree on the order (Wikipedia 60,058 v 59,500, Transfermarkt 60,449 v 60,100, fussballdaten 60,058 v 60,100), so they share 3rd and 4th as a pool. Other small differences: Dortmund 81,359 (fussballdaten), Bayern 75,000 (Transfermarkt), Gladbach 54,057 and Koln 49,698 and Leipzig 47,800 (Wikipedia), Werder Bremen 41,800 (Transfermarkt); none changes the order. No two 2025/26 clubs share a ground (Hamburg and St Pauli play at different stadiums), so the shared-ground rule is not needed.
